steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary without searching or creating another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order popup.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order popup, verify Product Sheet, Auction Configurations, Delivery Date and Schedule this event are present; select 24 Hrs for Event End Time Duration, keep Evaluation Duration at 30 Mins with no schedule, click Create Order, and verify the new event opens live immediately with a new stage code, the same product, quantity, location and participants, and Bidding Ends At exactly 1440 minutes after its start while the original closed event remains unchanged.

steps.note: No catalog domain step can operate the Recreate Order popup or validate its resulting cross-event details, so perform this buyer-side flow directly on screen.
Assert that the recreated event retains the source RFQ quantity.
Confirm the live recreated event displays its bidding end time.
Confirm the recreated event page has no rendering errors, raw values or server failures.
